findings.initial_behavior: A successful locked Petras fixture prints two diagnostic lines before its final JSON. Parsing the entire stdout using json.loads always fails.
findings.final_behavior: parse_native_marker validates the final exact typed JSON and the two expected diagnostic prefixes; the caller refuses truncated stdout. Locked fixture remains unchanged.

findings.initial_behavior: Stage receipt JSON hashes alone did not rehash the actual build stdout/stderr files named inside those receipts.
findings.final_behavior: Runner includes stream identity dictionaries and the gate hashes both stream files per build-stage record, in addition to the receipt.
